about.title: Ibyerekeye Minevam Kigobe
about.paragraph1: Yasimbuwe mu 2004 mu mutima wa Bujumbura, Itorero Minevam Kigobe ryatangiye n'itsinda rito ry'abemera bari bafite intego yo kwirakwiza urukundo rw'Imana muri Burundi yose. Mu myaka irenga makumyabiri, twahindutse umuryango ufite abandi birenga 1.200 bafatanye n'ukwizera, icyizere n'urukundo.
about.paragraph2: Itorero ryacu rishingiye ku kwemera ko buri muntu afite agaciro n'ubushobozi bungana. Dushaka kuba ahantu hose bose bafashe, bose bafite agaciro, kandi bose bashobora kubahirizwa n'ubushobozi bw'Amagambo y'Imana n'umuryango.
about.missionDesc: Gukunda Imana n'umutima wose no gukorera umuryango wacu n'impuhwe, dukoreza impinduka muri buri buzima dutanga kuri Bujumbura n'ibindi.
about.visionDesc: Kuba urumuri rw'icyizere n'urumuri kuri Burundi yose — itorero rita abigishwa bafite ingaruka ku ruhare rwabo kandi basigira inyigisho z'umwuka.
about.valuesDesc: Ukwizera, Umuryango, Ubucuti, n'ubwitange. Turabemera ubushobozi bw'umuryango ufite urukundo, gusenga n'intego yo kwikorera.

services.title: Gahunda y'amasengesho
services.subtitle: Dukorana buri gihe kugira ngo dusenge, dusabe kandi dukure hamwe. Bose murakaze!
services.earlyWorshipDesc: Tangira wa Mungu wawe n'ubukene bw'gusenga
services.mainServiceDesc: Ikoraniro ryacu rikuru n'ishimwe, gusenga n'Amagambo
services.bibleStudyDesc: Kwiga Amagambo n'igice cy'umuryango hagati y'icyumweru
services.prayerFastingDesc: Gusaba hamwe n'gusaba kuri igihugu cyacu
services.location: Itorero Minevam Kigobe, Quartier Kigobe, Bujumbura, Burundi
services.doorsOpen: Amaduru afungurwa iminota 30 mbere y'isengesho buri gihe • Amafaranga y'imparking yabafasha

sermons.title: Inkuru nziza n'inyigisho
sermons.subtitle: Uhindurwe n'ubukomera bw'ubwenge bwawe. Reba kandi unyumve ubutumwa buhindura ubuzima igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
sermons.latestVideosSubtitle: Videwo nshasha ziva kuri YouTube no kuri Facebook.

events.title: Ibyabaye n'amatangazo
events.event1Desc: Umunsi wuzuye w'gusaba hamwe n'igomwa kuri igihugu cyacu n'umuryango.
events.event2Desc: Inama y'abana n'ishimwe, ubutumwa bukomeza n'igihe cy'ubucuti.
events.event3Desc: Dutegereze kugira ngo dukorere umuryango wacu n'ibiryo, gusaba n'Ubutumwa bwiza.
events.event4Desc: Twisenge hamwe n'ubuzima bushya bw'Umwami wacu Yezu Kristo n'umunezero n'ishimwe!
events.event5Desc: Ifunguro ry'ubutanga kugira ngo dukorere porogaramu yacu y'abana b'imfubyi.
events.event6Desc: Umunsi w'gusaba umuryango n'imikorere, umuziki n'ubucuti.
events.announcement1: 🙏 Ikoraniro rya gusenga riraba abandi — Twandikire Minisiteri y'ishimwe
events.announcement2: 📚 Isomo ry'ubatizo: Ku wa Mungu 10h nyuma y'isengesho, iminota 3 ikurikira
events.announcement3: 💝 Gukusanya impuzu k'abana bakennye — kugeza kuwa 28 Werurwe
events.announcement4: 🎓 Amasomero yabafasha abanyeshuri b'abagize — reba biro by'itorero

ministries.title: Minisiteri zacu
ministries.subtitle: Hari ahantu k'umuntu wese kuri Minevam Kigobe. Shaka umuryango wawe kandi utangire gukorera uyu munsi.
ministries.choirDesc: Minisiteri yacu y'ishimwe iterera umuryango mu gusenga gukomeza. Chorale ihurira buri wa gatandatu.
ministries.youthDesc: Aho abana bafite imyaka 13–35 bakura mu kwizera, bakura abayobozi kandi bakorera ukwizera bwabo buri munsi.
ministries.outreachDesc: Turaba abakennye cyane kuri Bujumbura — abana b'imfubyi, abapfakazi n'abatagira aho — n'urukundo n'ubuvugizi.
ministries.kidsDesc: Aho abana bafite imyaka 0–12 bamenya urukundo rw'Imana n'inkuru, indirimbo n'imikorere.
ministries.missionsDesc: Kuzana ubutumwa bwiza hanze y'itorero — mu mihanda, imidugudu n'ibintu bya Burundi.
ministries.sundaySchoolDesc: Inyigisho z'uburyo bwiza k'abakuru — amasomo, amatsinda n'amabwiriza k'abigishwa.

gallery.title: Icyerekezo cy'igihe
gallery.subtitle: Ibyerekana icyo Imana ikora muri n'inyuma y'umuryango wacu kuri Bujumbura.

prayer.title: Gusaba kwiyambaza
prayer.subtitle: Sangira icyo usaba kwiyambaza kandi itsinda ryacu rya gusaba rizakugira imbere y'Imana. Nturi wenyine — turabemera ubushobozi bw'gusaba hamwe.
prayer.confidentiality: Icyo usaba kikorwa n'ubwiza n'ubwihisho n'itsinda ryacu rya gusaba.
prayer.thankYou: Murakoze kubera ko utwigiriye icyo usaba kwiyambaza. Itsinda ryacu rizagusaba neza.
prayer.verse: Gusaba gukora n'ubukene bw'umuntu wese kirakora cyane. — Yakobo 5:16

newsletter.title: Komeza kubonana
newsletter.subtitle: Kwiyandikisha kugira ngo ukire amakuru y'inyigisho, amakuru y'ibyabaye n'amakuru y'ubukene buri cyumweru.
newsletter.privacy: Tubahiriza ubwihisho bwawe. Kwiyandikisha igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
newsletter.subscribed: Ubu uri kwiyandikisha. Reba inbox yawe kugira ngo ubone ubutumwa bwa murakaze.
